narr: Strong to severe thunderstorms moved across much of north and central GA during the afternoon and evening hours of July 21st. Numerous reports of damaging winds, along with significant flash flooding (around downtown Atlanta) occurred along the I-20 corridor. Another area impacted by damaging winds occurred from Stewart County (far SE part of the FFC forecast area) to near Swainsboro in Emanuel County.
ev: The public reported roadway flooding along Northside Drive NW near the intersection of Arden Road NW. Radar estimates indicate that between 3 and 4 inches of rain occurred over the area, resulting in the flash flooding in the roadway.
The public reported stalled cars from high water near Huff Road NW. Radar estimates indicate that between 3 and 4 inches of rain occurred over the area, resulting in the flash flooding.
The broadcast media relayed a report of street flooding along Meadowdale Ave NE. Radar estimates indicate that between 3 and 4 inches of rain occurred over the area, resulting in the flash flooding.
A NWS Employee reported flooding near the Fox Theater. Radar estimates indicate that between 3 and 4 inches of rain occurred over the area, resulting in the flash flooding.

The Emergency Manager reported roadway flooding near the intersection of Regal Path Lane and Royal Path Court. Radar estimates indicate that between 3 and 4 inches of rain occurred over the area, resulting in the flash flooding in the roadway.

The broadcast media relayed a report of road flooding near the intersection of Highway 78 and Somerset Terrace NE. Radar estimates indicate that between 3 and 4 inches of rain occurred over the area, resulting in the flash flooding.
